articles.title: A Week of Symfony #1035 (October 26 – November 1, 2026)
articles.description: This week, Symfony 5.4.55, 6.4.49, 7.4.22, and 8.1.10 maintenance versions were released. We also released Symfony AI 1.0.0-BETA1 and kicked off the Symfony AI & MCP Hackathon, which runs until November 22. Meanwhile, we kept publishing articles about…
